SEARCH
Module jakarta.data
Package jakarta.data.expression

Interface NavigableExpression<T,U>

Type Parameters:
T - entity type
U - type of the intermediate object whose attributes can be navigated to
All Known Subinterfaces:
NavigableAttribute<T,U>, NavigablePath<T,U,V>
public interface NavigableExpression<T,U>
An expression whose type has attributes of its own that can be navigated.

The navigate methods accept a metamodel attribute of an intermediate type U and return a path expression rooted at the entity type T. The type of the returned expression is determined by the type of the attribute argument.

For example, given a Customer entity with an embeddable, shippingAddress, of type Address, 


 Restrict.all(_Customer.shippingAddress.navigate(_Address.city)
                                       .equalTo("Rochester"),
              _Customer.shippingAddress.navigate(_Address.state)
                                       .equalTo(StateCode.MN));

The following Jakarta Persistence entity and embeddable types are used in examples throughout the documentation of this class. 


 @Entity
 public class Customer {
     @Id
     long id;
     @Embedded
     Address shippingAddress;
 }

 @Embeddable
 public class Address {
     @Embedded
     BuildingInfo building;
     String city;
     StateCode state; // enum
     LocalDate validFrom;
     boolean verified;
     int zip;
 }

 @Embeddable
 public class BuildingInfo {
     String buildingName;
     int floor;
     String officeNum;
 }

The static metamodel would include, 


 @StaticMetamodel(Customer.class)
 public interface _Customer {
     String ID = "id";
     String SHIPPING_ADDRESS = "shippingAddress";

     NumericAttribute<Customer, Long> id =
             NumericAttribute.of(Customer.class, ID, long.class);
     NavigableAttribute<Customer, Address> shippingAddress =
             NavigableAttribute.of(Customer.class, SHIPPING_ADDRESS, Address.class);
 }

 @StaticMetamodel(Address.class)
 public interface _Address {
     String BUILDING = "building";
     String CITY = "city";
     String STATE = "state";
     String VALID_FROM = "validFrom";
     String VERIFIED = "verified";
     String ZIP = "zip";

     NavigableAttribute<Address, BuildingInfo> building =
             NavigableAttribute.of(Address.class, BUILDING, BuildingInfo.class);
     TextAttribute<Address> city =
             TextAttribute.of(Address.class, CITY);
     ComparableAttribute<Address, StateCode> state =
             ComparableAttribute.of(Address.class, STATE, StateCode.class);
     TemporalAttribute<Address, LocalDate> validFrom =
             TemporalAttribute.of(Address.class, VALID_FROM, LocalDate.class);
     BooleanAttribute<Address> verified =
             BooleanAttribute.of(Address.class, VERIFIED, boolean.class);
     NumericAttribute<Address, Integer> zip =
             NumericAttribute.of(Address.class, ZIP, int.class);
 }

 @StaticMetamodel(BuildingInfo.class)
 public interface _BuildingInfo {
     String BUILDING_NAME = "buildingName";
     String FLOOR = "floor";
     String OFFICE_NUM = "officeNum";

     TextAttribute<BuildingInfo> buildingName =
             TextAttribute.of(BuildingInfo.class, BUILDING_NAME);
     NumericAttribute<BuildingInfo, Integer> floor =
             NumericAttribute.of(BuildingInfo.class, FLOOR, int.class);
     TextAttribute<BuildingInfo> officeNum =
             TextAttribute.of(BuildingInfo.class, OFFICE_NUM);
 }

  • Method Details

    • navigate

      @Nonnull default <V> NavigableExpression<T,V> navigate(@Nonnull NavigableAttribute<U,V> attribute)
      Allows navigation to an attribute that can be further navigated.

      The resulting NavigableExpression represents the path formed by navigating from this expression to the given navigable attribute of type V. The intermediate type V must itself have attributes that can be further navigated to.

      Example: 

      
 List<Customer> notOnFirstFloor = customers.search(
         _Customer.shippingAddress.navigate(_Address.building)
                                  .navigate(_BuildingInfo.floor)
                                  .notEqualTo(1));
      Type Parameters:
      V - type of the attribute, which must itself be navigable
      Parameters:
      attribute - the navigable attribute to which to navigate
      Returns:
      a NavigableExpression representing the path to the given attribute
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the attribute is null

                                  .equalTo("Minneapolis"));
      Parameters:

      Returns:
      a TextExpression representing the path to the given attribute.
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the attribute is null

      @Nonnull default <N extends Number & Comparable<N>> NumericExpression<T,N> navigate(@Nonnull NumericAttribute<U,N> attribute)
      Represents navigation to a NumericAttribute.

      Obtains a NumericExpression representing the path formed by navigating from this expression to the given numeric attribute.

      Example:

         _Customer.shippingAddress.navigate(_Address.zip)
                                  .between(55901, 55906));
      Type Parameters:
      N - type of the numeric attribute
      Parameters:
      attribute - the numeric attribute to which to navigate
      Returns:
      a NumericExpression representing the path to the given attribute.
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the attribute is null

      @Nonnull default <V extends Temporal & Comparable<? extends Temporal>> TemporalExpression<T,V> navigate(@Nonnull TemporalAttribute<U,V> attribute)
      Represents navigation to a TemporalAttribute.

      Obtains a TemporalExpression representing the path formed by navigating from this expression to the given temporal attribute.

      Example: 

      
 List<Customer> found = customers.search(
         _Customer.shippingAddress.navigate(_Address.validFrom)
                                  .lessThanEqual(CurrentDate.now()));
      Type Parameters:
      V - type of the temporal attribute
      Parameters:
      attribute - the temporal attribute to which to navigate
      Returns:
      a TemporalExpression representing the path to the given attribute
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the attribute is null
